citations.claim: after one dt=1/30 step energy jumps to ~2445 J, exceeding allowed 2348 J
velocity gained ~6 m/s in 1/30 s under g=30 (expects ~1 m/s), showing gravity over-applied

counterfactual.change: Changed only dt from 1/30 to 0.001; gravity work per step becomes correct (~1 m/s per 1/30s scaled) so energy stays at ~2130 J and no energy_bound violation.

explanation: With dt=1/30, g=30, vy=-60, the engine reports 71 substeps in the single step, final vy=-66 (delta 6) instead of expected g*dt=1. Gravity appears applied once per substep with full dt (71x over-integration), adding ~315 J kinetic+potential error and breaching energy_bound by ~97 J beyond tolerance. Small-dt counterfactual with same physics but 3 substeps gains correct 0.03 m/s and passes.
vision_note: The single body drops from near the top of the arena at step 0 to much lower mid-arena at step 1, covering meters in one frame. There is no wall, collision, or controller action visible to explain such a large jump, just free fall.
